name: Skeletal muscle fibre / satellite cell
failures: Dystrophies, sarcopenia with age, denervation atrophy, cachexia.

see.note: Biopsy and MRI work; whole-body fibre-level state does not exist.

model.note: Healthy muscle is well characterised; the ageing set-point is contested.

reach.note: Systemic AAV reaches muscle but total body mass makes dose the binding limit.

edit.note: Elevidys for Duchenne, FDA 2023 — accelerated, and the benefit remains debated.

verify.note: Function tests and dystrophin expression; long-term durability unproven.
